reviews.text: Best daycare, with a wonderful team, I can only recommend it :)

We have been going to DogOffice for years, both as a daycare and boarding house. The owner and all the colleagues are very kind, attentive, and professional. For me, the best feedback is that my dog ​​always comes in with joy and welcomes you with a pleasant tiredness and calmness. I can only recommend it!:))

We are dog daycare owners, with over a year and a half of on-site experience. Our experience is a family atmosphere, reliability, and expertise, and we entrust our dogs to the DogOffice team with complete peace of mind and trust, who, last but not least, are happy to go.
If your dog loves to play, and you like it when he gets tired on his own, this is the place for him! In good hands, in good company.

Oreo has been attending the daycare for almost 3 years. Since then, not only has he made friends, but we have also met some extraordinary people. 🥹🤍 Dogoffice is more than a daycare. We can be part of a supportive community, where if anyone needs help, they will do everything in their power. 🙏🏽 We are proud and grateful that we can come here with complete confidence ☺️☀️

We went to see it, unfortunately the dogs were alone outside in a small yard, we stood there for about fifteen minutes. :(
We didn't check in, we just left because we wanted to go in and see the place.
Our dog has been coming here for several years, and Laci and the girls are very conscientious.

We are very grateful for this dog boarding house!
Laci is an extremely kind and reliable person, it is obvious that he loves animals. Everyone treats the dogs with care and competence, I can always know that my dog ​​is safe and in good hands. A plus point is that they not only supervise them, but also take care of them, play with them, exercise them, and really pay attention to everyone. They are not afraid of even the most distrustful, difficult cases😊
I can only recommend it🫶
We have been taking our puppy to daycare and boarding for years. I highly recommend the place, both professionally and in terms of attitude! 😍 …

We've been coming here for years! Oreo is always welcomed and we always get photos of how happy our dog is with the others. But the surest sign of feedback is that the dog sleeps all day the next day because he's so tired from playing all day. ❤️❤️
Everything was fine, they looked after our dog for 4 days with great professionalism, they listened to every extra request. I can only recommend them

The colleagues are very nice and helpful, the owner is very nice :) The dogs always go with pleasure and leave very tired ;)
Super team I can only recommend it, whether you take your pet for 1 day or 1 week 10/10 :)
A family-friendly environment, expert attention for your four-legged friends.

I couldn't wait for my dog ​​to get used to it, but it never happened. The place is great with a briefcase temperament, and for average family dogs, etc. The traditional boarding house conditions, small yard, tight spaces with so many strange dogs, are not suitable for mine.
Only 4 stars because the communication and handling of the situation were not exactly phenomenal.
We have been there several times, everything was always fine with the dog.
Super nice team. I would happily entrust my dog ​​to them. I highly recommend it
